headline: Argentina Introduces Tax and Credit Measures to Support Economic Activity
summary: Amid rising country risk reaching 831 basis points, Argentina's Economy Minister Luis Caputo announced new tax changes, subsidies, and a credit line for the automotive sector to revive economic activity.
why: Fiscal policy adjustments and targeted stimulus affect domestic consumption, industrial recovery, and investor confidence in emerging sovereign debt markets.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Government stimulus measures aim to support domestic industry while sovereign bond yields remain elevated.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Rising country risk and falling sovereign bond prices prompted the government to launch targeted relief measures to stimulate growth.
